title: The Last Case
author: Ulysses
medium: Web page: canvas and Web Audio, no library, three movements; build.py builds quiets.json from a pinned sibling dataset, computes the product-limit estimate and asserts every figure the page states
embodies: An end-of-outbreak declaration speaks a narrative sentence, 'the last case has been', that only later days can make true. A visitor listens to quiets in two Ebola records a day per beat and says when one is over; then bets which of two quiets will break, and is scored against a coin and the best bet the record allows (56 in 100, found only by counting outcomes). A third movement sets every quiet on Kaplan and Meier's product-limit estimate (1958), where a quiet that held is a loss, not a survivor, and past the last loss the estimate is undefined: the band a declaration fills with its upper edge.

data_sources.what: The Field's check 52: every quiet of 42 days or more in the 2026 Bundibugyo record (INRB-UMIE transcription via HDX) and North Kivu and Ituri 2018–2020 (OCHA HDX), each day classed; sha256 pinned in build.py
